scenes.title: Characters by Emotion, State, Age and Fortune
scenes.summary: Next come the characters, according to the emotions, the states, the ages, youth, the prime and old age, and fortune: good birth, wealth, power and their opposites.

scenes.title: The Young
scenes.summary: The young are full of appetite and changeable, passionate, fonder of honor and victory than of money, trusting and hopeful, courageous, prone to shame and great-souled, fond of their friends; they do everything too much, against Chilon's maxim, do wrong through outrage, pity readily and love laughter, for wit is educated outrage.
